[[Image:Lordamere Internment Camp.jpg|thumb|Lordamere Internment Camp]]
'''Lordamere Internment Camp''' is the only [[Internment Camp]] based in [[Dalaran]]. It is located on a hill overlooking the rebuilding city, and is defended by Dalaran forces. Four treacherous [[forsaken]] hide here, and agents of the [[Horde]] are asked to seek them out and  kill them for their misdeeds.
